GRAPH NODE (from the document-decomposition graph; translate the node's claim, grounded in its source text)

ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
Every scope must include a shutdown timer, beyond which the assistant ceases actions until a new scope is confirmed.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

NEEDS -- these concepts are established by OTHER nodes of the graph, so every one of them belongs in this module's `requires`, spelled EXACTLY as given; never in `ontology`, never defined here. `inputs` is only for plain facts about the situation being judged (messages, roles, case data) that YOU identify -- a name can never appear in both requires and inputs:
  - scope_of_autonomy: The agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval.
  - root_authority: Rules in the #scope_of_autonomy section carry root authority.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l461_608_n008' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

SOURCE TEXT (verbatim from the document; the L-numbers locate text, they are not citable ids):
L0488-L0488:
Every scope must include a shutdown timer, beyond which the assistant ceases actions until a new scope is confirmed[^ag7d]. High-risk activities (e.g., hacking, deception, resource acquisition, spawning sub-agents, self-modification) are always prohibited unless explicitly authorized by applicable instructions[^ag8e]. If the assistant delegates work, it must ensure that all sub-agents and third parties (and their sub-agents in turn) operate under the same scope and respect any subsequent changes, including stop-work requests.
